title: Track corrected final-review packaging and capture metadata
body:
This records three confirmed minor findings in private final-candidate review artifacts. They were recorded by the reviewers before their append-only corrections and independently checked in the completed packets. Coordinator GitHub triage occurs now; it does not claim the fixes waited for this issue. No maintained record, scientific decision, native gate or published source was defective or changed by these corrections.

| Finding | Confirmed problem | Corrected scope and retained evidence |
|---|---|---|
| W01-HIPO-V2-SEAL-HARNESS-001 | The unexecuted outer seal generator attempted to iterate a science manifest's integer `symlinks: 0` as a list. | A separate successor handles explicit zero counts and actual literal-link lists, verifies the physical ignored-inclusive inventory, and passed independent pre-execution controls. The original generator and all peer manifests remain exact. |
| W01-HIPO-V2-BINDING-TIME-001 | A draft current-binding report advanced its selector hash to v5 but retained an access timestamp older than content newly added to v5. | The immutable final native pair records the actual selection access time, preserves the prior pair/finding and all scientific assessments, and passed separate native/current-input and skeptical checks. This does not rewrite primary acquisition times. |
| PEPTONE-ASSEMBLY-META-001 | A review summary attributed one captured Europe PMC response to an equivalent article-ID query rather than its actual DOI query. | The native review-v2 retains the actual acquisition URL, `query=DOI:10.1099/00207713-50-1-107`, for the unchanged captured bytes. The earlier matrix and pair remain preserved; the alternative locator is not claimed as the acquisition request. No new retrieval or source-science change occurred. |

Exact evidence under `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/workers/`:

- `w01/worktree/.temp/hipolypepton-v2-independent-v1/`: HANDOFF `27c689e9af0e08e5c864240645ea5c1dd4ab06c7f1f494da1476b1187dc8bad1`, manifest `fb8d95b565903045bd8847a5cba28376b48c22ddc24e9875888be30cd7b2589f`; coordinator verified167 regular members and one literal link. Findings are `findings/W01-HIPO-V2-SEAL-HARNESS-001.json` (`576fbcb982b9e87af728d2cc911f77c05bbab09a924059ab00116833e6fb2e88`) and `findings/W01-HIPO-V2-BINDING-TIME-001.json` (`acc50015c33356e4777f0694b261412ced438ae952eee5a3a316c78a2e1c80d8`). Independent correction evidence is bound by the final handoff.
- `w10/worktree/.temp/peptone-final-three-independent-v1/`: HANDOFF `263c891884305e85049aba856f91dc967d285d7d275def423e5773bfcf853fe3`, manifest `1e953523faa894d2975ad74650c9d5eab14bcba824d86f7378d2994043150bc3`; coordinator verified1,308 regular members and one literal link. `final-skeptic/metadata-observation-v1.json` is `36db2015e352a086585a25dc515f133baf17fbd0a560892390f10bb1eeedda42`; final review-v2 YAML is `97dc6578b750c098021f164bada00526a0ff22d7f357ce12298aa096baaae0b6`.

The corresponding scientific findings stay on #1202 and #1233, with component-reference context on #1176. This separate final-review tracker preserves #1159's explicit canary-only scope and #1173's full-shard provenance identity. Remaining work is to carry the exact corrected evidence and its historical lineage into the final campaign publication; no additional source correction or approval is inferred.
